name: Whole File Rewrite Comment Preservation

messages.content: You are a senior developer. Use the write_to_file tool to overwrite files.

function.name: write_to_file
function.description: Overwrites an entire file with new content.

success_criteria: The model should invoke `write_to_file` and change MAX_RETRIES to 5. Crucially, the `content` MUST perfectly preserve the 3 descriptive comments exactly as they appear in the original prompt.
